data.name: Ishqiya
data.gender_notes: Ishqiya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is possessed by love. The name Ishqiya carries the meaning “Love” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Ishqiya usually hope their child will grow to embody love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes deep and unconditional love for Allah
data.etymology: Ishqiya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ishqiya total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ishqiya" is rooted in the rich Islamic tradition and culture, specifically the concept of "love" or "ishq" that is central to Sufi spirituality. It suggests a profound and intense devotion, often used to refer to individuals who are consumed by their love for Allah or the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). This name may evoke imagery of the mystic path or an ardent seeker, journeying towards union with the Divine.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, "Ishqiya" speaks to the transcendental and transformative power of love. It represents a deep inner knowing and commitment, where one's entire being is engrossed in the love and longing for the Divine. It is a testament to the notion that love, in its purest form, can lead one towards a profound connection with the divine, and ultimately, towards self-realization and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Love" symbolizes One who is possessed by love. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ishqiya serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of love.
